name: ibkr
description: Read-only Interactive Brokers market data for AI agents: historical bars down to 30-second resolution, event windows around a timestamp, and a local parquet store, plus setup, login, status and market-data skills. It reaches the service over a local address, so it works from any folder and inside Cowork, not only in the folder holding the clone. It cannot place an order.

ibkr_token.title: Market data key
ibkr_token.description: The key printed by the market data setup on this computer. It is local to your machine and grants nothing anywhere else.

ibkr_url.title: Market data address
ibkr_url.description: Leave this alone unless the setup told you otherwise. The default is the service on your own computer.
